purpose: Validate wall-clock accounting for a coverage-audited screen using raw execution rows and the matching single-boot budget ledger
requirements: bind input hashes, GPU and execution commit
reject clock regressions, overlapping or unfinished work and inconsistent identities
separate six execution phases and observed gaps
attribute default timing to a candidate only with an unambiguous pair
report partial and unstarted candidates explicitly
interpretation: Work intervals include process/JIT/guard overhead and are not pure compilation time. Ledger span excludes unobserved build, manifest and cleanup time and is not the whole reserved GPU budget. Full campaign cost must also use campaign and phase records.
